prompts.clinic:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: flat game albedo texture atlas, NOT a mockup or photograph of a card.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the project's approved blank paper atlas. Preserve its square canvas, the exact 50/50 front-left/back-right UV layout, separator, warm pink-tan paper color, fibers, existing faint rules and red header rule. Add only printed and handwritten ink. Keep the entire right half (back) visually unchanged and blank. No physical holes, outer silhouettes, bevels, shadows, perspective, light gradients, logos, crosses, blood, stamps or extra props.
The left/front half is a narrow portrait form. All new ink must stay inside global image X 6%-45%, Y 5%-87%; never cross the center separator. Leave a completely unprinted clearance around global X 10%, Y 13.5% for the existing 3D punched hole. Header may sit in global X 16%-44%, Y 5%-11%, to the right of the hole. Keep the original red rule at its current height.
Style: restrained utilitarian printed form in small worn charcoal type, entries added in believable slightly hurried dark blue-black ballpoint handwriting with natural pressure variation. Not calligraphy, not digitally perfect, no decorative script. Sufficient dark ink to read as a completed used record at game pickup distance, with generous blank paper between sections. Use the exact specified words/numbers only, no extra pseudo-writing or invented dates/identities. Do not fill the whole card with story prose.
Output one full square opaque atlas at the source aspect ratio. Flat neutral albedo only.
Variant: CLINIC TRIAGE CARD.
Printed small header exactly "CLINIC TRIAGE".
In upper form area below red rule (Y 23%-40%), print "NAME" with a short genuinely illegible worn-out/smeared entry, NOT a readable invented name; print "SEX" with handwritten "Male"; print "AGE" with handwritten "~40".
In middle area Y 45%-61%, print "OBSERVATIONS", then two handwritten lines exactly "Exposure" and "Lacerations — both hands".
In lower area Y 65%-84%, print "CARE", with two small checked boxes followed by handwritten entries exactly "Iodine" and "Blanket".
No date, signature, invented triage category or added patient details. Keep the lower and outer margins empty.
